text:
sam_k: Heads up — seeing a spike in task failures on the hopper-h100 pool after the driver 535.86 rollout in asia-east1. Pods keep restarting with 'ptx_jit_compile_failed' and 'unsatisfied compute capability' in the logs. Paused the canary but need engineers on call.

elaine: Yep seeing it too. nvidia-smi shows 535.86, CUDA 12.2. dmesg has repeated: "ptxJit: invalid PTX version 900" and "nvidia: module verification failed: signature" — kernel module rejected on a handful of nodes.

raj: Are you seeing NCCL hang traces as well? A couple of large training jobs in dedicated pool had allreduce stalls and timeouts, NCCL reports version mismatch on init.

noah: Quick node inspect: kubectl describe node hopper-az1-003 -> NodeReady but kubelet shows "Failed to start plugin nvidia" and dmesg contains "unable to load nvidia_uvm: -2". Pod events: CrashLoopBackOff with exit code 139.

infra-bot: deploy pipeline triggered: driver-build/535.86 deployed to asia-east1; rollout started at 1793456000 by image-builder. Canary size = 5 nodes.

elaine: Mitigation plan proposal: 1) cordon & drain affected nodes (drain --ignore-daemonsets), 2) route new allocations to us-west hopper pool, 3) enable model-run fallback to sm80 quantized variants where possible to avoid SM90-specific kernels.

sam_k: Can we force a PTX fallback at runtime? I think some kernels are being JIT-compiled to SM90 and failing. Quick option: pin driver to 535.75 on canary nodes and re-run kernel compile tests.

raj: I pulled a failed pod log, snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T10:12:02Z] cuda: PTX JIT error: ptxJitCompile failed: 'ptxJit: unsupported ptx version 900'
[2026-03-18T10:12:02Z] aborting kernel launch: unsatisfied compute capability 90
```
Seems like the toolchain produced PTX 900 artifacts that this driver variant rejects.

noah: I did a reimage on hopper-az1-003 and downgraded to 535.75, modules load but one job still shows degraded throughput. dmesg after downgrade: "NVRM: GPU at 0000:af:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus" for a transient period.

sam_k: Paused the global fleet rollout. Can someone open a vendor ticket with these logs (dmesg + nvidia-bug-report) and tag support? We need confirmation if 535.86 enforces a newer PTX/SM90 minimum or if there's a packaging error in our kernel module builds.

elaine: Opened ticket INC-2026-423 to vendor + attached: kubectl describe, dmesg, nvidia-smi outputs, one failed pod log. Also put a note on cost impact: routing to us-west/backfilling increases cross-region egress and warmup overhead. Quick estimate: ~+$2k/day if we keep fallback for sustained 48h.

raj: Short-term: cordon affected nodes, pin driver to 535.75 for stable canary, add a preflight in the upgrade job that runs a small SM90 PTX compile + a NCCL allreduce check. I'll draft a rollout gating change.

noah: Also recommend adding a kprobe check for nvidia_uvm during post-upgrade smoke tests and an automated reimage fallback if module load fails.

sam_k: Sounds good. I'll notify infra leads and schedule a 30-min triage. Please drop any extra logs into the ticket thread. For now do not promote 535.86 beyond asia-east canary. :exclamation:
